title: 별빛 물약 실험 수업
description: 구름 위 마법학교의 반짝이는 물약 실험실에서 아기 용과 견습생들 사이 다섯 가지 변화를 찾아보세요.
theme: 꼬마 용 마법학교 대모험 — 별빛 물약 실험 수업
scene: A cheerful potion-brewing classroom inside the same whimsical dragon academy high above the clouds, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. Tall arched windows reveal a clear blue sky and soft clouds; cream stone walls, dark-teal beams, antique-brass pipes, plum-purple blank pennants, wooden shelves, and organized worktables create a cozy magical laboratory. At center, the recurring friendly young red baby dragon stands fully visible behind a low cream worktable and wears one oversized plum-purple pointed wizard hat whose broad front bears one large antique-gold crescent-moon badge. At upper left, exactly three large round potion bottles sit in a straight row on an isolated cream shelf: vivid turquoise, sunflower yellow, and coral red from left to right; each bottle has the same plain cork and no label. At lower left, one large cobalt-blue cauldron stands front-facing on a clear brass trivet; its cream oval front panel bears one oversized vivid-turquoise five-point-star emblem. At upper right, one large antique-brass balance scale is fully visible against a simple pale wall; its left pan contains exactly two large separate plum-purple crystal gems while its right pan is empty. At lower right, one large closed natural-leather spellbook lies alone on a cream table, facing the viewer; it has one oversized vivid-turquoise diamond-shaped clasp centered on its front edge and a blank cover with no markings. The gentle owl teacher in a deep-teal robe supervises from the far left, and a small mouse apprentice with round brass goggles stirs a plain glass beaker near the right table. Add blank jars, wooden spoons, coiled hose, folded cloths, tiny golden sparkles, and small cloud puffs only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the yellow center potion bottle, gold crescent badge, turquoise cauldron star, two purple scale crystals, and turquoise diamond book clasp large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, runes, logos, or clock numerals.
